evals.prompt: Record my decision: I chose PostgreSQL over MySQL because it's the team standard.
evals.description: Happy path: decision with choice and because fields. Verifies decisions/log.mem is appended with the correct +decision: format including timestamp.
evals.expected_output: decisions/log.mem gains a new entry in the format: ~DATETIME +decision:choice=PostgreSQL,because=team-standard (or similar). The timestamp is in ISO 8601 format.

assertions.text: .memplan/decisions/log.mem contains a +decision: entry after the skill runs
The +decision: entry includes a choice= field with the stated choice (PostgreSQL or use-postgres)
The +decision: entry includes a because= field with the stated reason (team-standard or similar)
The +decision: entry is prefixed with a timestamp in the format ~YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ

evals.prompt: Record my decision: I'm using JWT tokens instead of sessions because they're stateless.
evals.description: Decision round-trip: decision is written to log.mem, then read back. Verifies the entry can be parsed and the choice/because fields are intact.
evals.expected_output: New entry appended to log.mem. Pre-existing redis-cache decision is preserved. The new JWT decision is written as: ~DATETIME +decision:choice=JWT-tokens,because=stateless (or similar).

assertions.text: .memplan/decisions/log.mem contains a +decision: entry for JWT tokens after the skill runs
The pre-existing redis-cache decision entry is still present in log.mem
The new decision entry includes choice=JWT-tokens (or use-jwt or jwt)
The new decision entry includes because=stateless (or similar rationale)

evals.prompt: Record a decision: I'll use a REST API instead of GraphQL because the team is more familiar with REST.
evals.description: Multiple decisions accumulate: log.mem already has 2 decisions. Verifies the third decision is appended without overwriting.
evals.expected_output: log.mem gains a third entry for the REST API decision. Both prior entries (postgres and docker-compose) are preserved.

assertions.text: .memplan/decisions/log.mem contains exactly 3 +decision: entries after the skill runs
The new decision entry includes choice=REST-API (or rest or rest-over-graphql)
The new decision entry includes because=team-familiarity (or similar rationale)
The postgres decision entry is still present in log.mem
The docker-compose decision entry is still present in log.mem

evals.prompt: Record my decision: use TypeScript over JavaScript for type safety.
evals.description: Timestamp format validation: verifies the decision entry timestamp is in ISO 8601 format with timezone (UTC).
evals.expected_output: log.mem gains a new entry with a properly formatted timestamp (~YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ) and decision fields (choice=TypeScript, because=type-safety).

assertions.text: .memplan/decisions/log.mem contains a +decision: entry
The timestamp follows ISO 8601 format: ~YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ (e.g. ~2026-05-28T16:30Z)
The decision entry includes choice=TypeScript (or typescript or ts)
The decision entry includes because=type-safety (or similar rationale)

evals.prompt: Record my decision: use Vite instead of Webpack because Vite has faster build times.
evals.description: MemScript format compliance: verifies the decision entry follows the MemScript v1 tag:key=value format exactly.
evals.expected_output: log.mem gains a new entry: ~DATETIME +decision:choice=Vite,because=faster-build-times. Format is MemScript-compliant (no spaces around =, comma-separated key=value pairs).

assertions.text: .memplan/decisions/log.mem contains a new +decision: entry for Vite
The entry follows MemScript v1 format: +decision:choice=VALUE,because=REASON (no spaces around = or after commas)
The decision entry includes choice=Vite (or vite or vite-over-webpack)
The decision entry includes because=faster-build-times (or build-speed or similar)
The pre-existing npm decision entry is still present in log.mem
